landing.faqDeliveryQ: How long does it take to launch my online store?
landing.faqDeliveryA: Choose a template, add your identity, and enter initial products in about five minutes (70%). The developer then reviews the design, configures domain and hosting, and verifies payment and shipping settings within 24–48 hours (30%).
landing.faqOwnershipQ: Do I own my store data and code?
landing.faqOwnershipA: Yes. You fully own your products, customer data, and orders, as well as the store copy delivered to you. Run it on managed hosting or deploy the standalone copy to your own hosting and domain.
landing.faqPaymentsQ: Does the store support COD and payment gateways in Egypt and Saudi Arabia?
landing.faqPaymentsA: Egyptian setups can include cash on delivery, transfers, and InstaPay or Vodafone Cash receipt workflows. Saudi setups can include Mada, STC Pay, Apple Pay, and bank transfers. Each gateway requires an eligible merchant account and provider configuration.
landing.faqToolsQ: What tools are available for orders, inventory, and marketing?
landing.faqToolsA: The dashboard includes order tracking, size-and-color stock alerts, CODE128 barcodes, printable A6 shipping waybills, Meta/TikTok/Snapchat pixel links, and abandoned-cart recovery when the required integrations are enabled.
landing.faqTrialQ: What happens after the 14-day free trial?
landing.faqTrialA: The public store is temporarily paused until you upgrade, while products, images, settings, and orders remain saved. Activating a paid subscription restores publishing without deleting your data.
landing.faqPlansQ: What is the difference between monthly subscriptions and turnkey packages?
landing.faqPlansA: A subscription lets you launch and manage your store yourself with ready-made templates and a 14-day free trial. Turnkey packages are developer-led setup services that customize the identity, add products, and configure integrations according to the selected scope.
